race.description: Congratulations Andrea Leek Cox Plate Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: HIMALAYAN (5) ran first up in the grey's BM90 at Flemington on Oaks day and ran a solid race to finish seventh. This is a far more suitable assignment and her best recent ratings stack up well for this grade. Hard to hold out. SUNLIT SERENADE (1) is the main danger despite the wide draw, with her first-up fifth in a BM70 on heavy ground easy enough to give a pass mark. Fitter now and will be running on strongly. FARAKTA (9) arrives with the sharpest last-start result after running second as favourite in a FM BM66 at Ballarat and she'll be at peak fitness. MELEYS (2) resumes from five months off with two trials behind her and a consistent overall profile. Nadia Daniels is riding well for the Hayes yard and can figure in the finish fresh. IMPONDERABLE (8) next best on resumption.
